gameName: 通用游戏与安卓模拟器

items: 插件前端升级到 Frontend API 1.5，改用公开 nxp-* 组件与宿主稳定 design token。
修复 Vue 前端发行产物在浏览器中无法挂载的问题。
迁移到 Frontend API 1.4 与 Vue 组件化实时预览界面。

en-US.description: Show a low-frequency preview of the current PC game or emulator screen in running task cards.

items: The plugin frontend targets Frontend API 1.5 and now uses public nxp-* elements with host design tokens.
Fixed the Vue frontend package so the live preview mounts in the browser.
Migrated the live preview interface to Frontend API 1.4 and Vue components.
